name: ticking-figure
title: TickingFigure
author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
description: A figure that counts to its value in tabular numerals. Use when a number arrives or changes and the movement is worth noticing.

hairline.purpose: Animates a number toward its value.
useWhen: a figure changes in response to an action
dontUseWhen: anything a screen reader must read once
hairline.antiExampleWhy: Proportional digits change width every frame, so the number jitters horizontally as it counts.

docs: Motion is opt-in and honours prefers-reduced-motion inside the hook, so no caller can forget it. On the server it renders the final value — never a half-counted figure.
